_meta.evidence_rule: Differentiates actual park/beach existence, anonymous posted plans, on-site reports, and map pin. 8-source cross-ref is incomplete for paywall/login pages, and no current unverified crowd claims are inferred.

records.name: Lobau
records.identity: Named Lobau landscape in Donau-Auen National Park Vienna. City of Vienna confirms visitor center at Dechantweg 8, with bus 92B access; that address is ONLY a public orienting visitor centre and must not be treated as source's cruising location. The saved 48.19411,16.46869 requires coordinate-to-reference reconciliation and must not be presented as exact source meeting pin.

dated_activity.detail: Austrian country-index original shows a user check-in, not independently verifiable physical attendance or cruising.

records.access: Official national park with marked hiking/cycling paths, protected areas and designated bathing waters. Dechantlacke is a separate officially identified natural bathing area; source one-word 'Lobau' does not prove equivalence.
records.duplicate: Toter Grund is nearby and independently named by source; neither automatic duplicate nor proven same place; original Toter Grund page lists Lobau 0.5km apart.
fixes: Current description correctly qualifies park office as orientation only
Check that coordinates are not actually pinned to Toter Grund or a different part of Lobau before future data revision
Do not imply Nationalparkhaus opening hours govern national park

records.name: Donauinsel, Toter Grund
records.identity: Toter Grund southern Danube Island/Austria Vienna; general area separately named from Lobau. Saved 48.18472,16.47333 plausible broad geographic point. City of Vienna explicitly defines southern FKK bathing stretch on Donauinsel/high-water embankment kilometres 2.1–5.1; historic source does not identify precise present sexual subarea.

dated_activity.detail: Poster says he will be there from 14:00; does not confirm encounter.

records.access: Official FKK areas are public marked bathing zones and include toilets, water supply; clothing optional doesn't mean sexual conduct authorised. River/open water and nature-protection rules apply.
records.duplicate: Nearby Lobau source listing 0.5 km away per original directory; retain separate as independently named site without proving duplicate.
fixes: Old source says heavily frequented in summer; this is an undated historical description, not established 2026 popularity
Don't treat planned meetups as real-world completed events

records.name: Figurteich
records.identity: Figurteich/Figurenteich (Brown-Boveri-Teich) is an independent 3.8-hectare pond between Südbahn and B17 near Wiener Neudorf/Guntramsdorf, per local fishing club. Saved 48.07156,16.30808 is a plausible pond area point, compared with OSM pond center 48.07097,16.30898 and naturist guide 48.07156,16.30808. It is NOT Windradlteich in Guntramsdorf.
records.access: Independent naturist guide describes unofficial free-clothing/nude bathing at Figurteich, no managed food/WC facilities. Local fishing club explicitly calls the pond a protected natural pond. No permission or exact cruising corner verified.
records.duplicate: Don't confuse Figurenteich with nearby Guntramsdorf Windradlteich, which has different official municipal entry fees.
fixes: Record both known names (Figurteich/Figurenteich, Brown-Boveri-Teich) for search
No recent eyewitness gay sex claims; naturist swimming ≠ cruising

records.name: Seapoint Beach
records.identity: Actual Seapoint Beach is County Dublin beside DART and Martello Tower, clearly NOT South Africa despite the original spot page's erroneous 'Western Cape-Sudáfrica' wording. Visit Dublin confirms public beach, high tide swimming and Martello Tower at NORTH end. Saved 53.297846,-6.159859 is general public beach/tower-area point.
records.access: Popular family swim beach with toilets/showers, summer lifeguards; rocky shore and high tides matter. Historic source references bridge over DART and tower, not verified present cruising zone.
records.duplicate: No evidence of exact duplicate with a distinct named DART bridge in this group. Maintain original name in evidence but corrected public place Dublin.
fixes: Improve original-source historical landmark: around railway bridge or Martello Tower, not claim that source only points to general beach
Do not use old claimed 'best 11–12' as verified 2026 hours
No confirmed firsthand activity in the visible 2026 comments

records.name: Phoenix Park Military Road
records.identity: Phoenix Park Dublin road named Military Road, saved Gays-Cruising Google driving point 53.3481445312,-6.3207435608. Original describes carpark but does not identify exact carpark. Phoenix Park operator names 'Soccer Pavilions on Military Road' car park at opening 08:30, though original directory cannot conclusively be tied to that lot.

dated_activity.detail: Current directory displays cumulative check-ins and last-month aggregate, but visible details/comments restricted to logged-in adults; neither dates nor eyewitness activity independently retrievable.

records.access: Phoenix Park open 24 hours, main Castleknock/Parkgate gates 24 hours, side gates approximately 07:00–22:45. Most car parks close one hour before dusk, including Soccer Pavilions on Military Road; Upper Glen Road and Knockmaroon 24h. Operator also warns of car break-ins. Do NOT say all Military Road parking available at night.
records.duplicate: Directory shows other Phoenix Park in night 1.4km away; no proof of same individual carpark. Avoid merge without GPS/source evidence.
fixes: Existing 2026 discussion claim in listing not independently retrievable from public full original detail; needs source evidence citation before treating dated post as confirmed
A directory aggregate check-in counter is not real world visit verification
Keep exact carpark unconfirmed, not just road
